entries.title: Confirmation links always land you in your dashboard
entries.description: Some links could sign you in and then leave you on the homepage.
highlights: Every confirmation link now finishes the handoff and opens your dashboard
When a link genuinely can't be completed, it says so and offers a fresh one

entries.title: Signing up now tells you to confirm your email
entries.description: New accounts get a clear "check your inbox" screen instead of a login page.
highlights: Shows which address the confirmation link went to
One-click resend if it doesn't arrive
Signing in before confirming now explains what to do instead of just failing

entries.title: Saved posts stay selected when you reopen an automation
entries.description: Reopening an automation now shows the posts it targets, already ticked.
highlights: Post and story selections come back exactly as you saved them
A note appears if a selected post is older than the list on screen
A cloned automation starts account-wide instead of claiming a post it

entries.title: Clearer release notes
entries.description: Each update now says what changed for you, in plain language.
highlights: Release notes no longer contain technical jargon
Older entries rewritten to match

entries.title: Every Instagram account now has its own space
entries.description: Connect multiple Instagram accounts and keep each one fully separate — its own AI agent, inbox, leads, analytics and link-in-bio page.
highlights: Switch accounts from the sidebar — the whole dashboard follows the account you pick
Each account has its own AI agent, so a persona set up for one never answers DMs on another
Leads, messages, analytics and insights are shown per account
Each account can have its own link-in-bio page

entries.title: Keyword rules that make sense for multiple accounts
entries.description: Keywords can now be reused wherever they don't overlap, and automations behave predictably when more than one could match a comment.
highlights: Use the same keyword on a different account, on a different post, or for a story trigger
Automations set for one specific post take priority over account-wide ones
Automations set for several posts now trigger on every one of them

entries.title: Accounts are labelled on every automation
entries.description: When you run more than one account, each automation now shows which account it belongs to.
highlights: Clear account badge on every automation card
The post and story pickers name the account they're showing
A warning appears if an automation's account has been disconnected

entries.title: Pull-to-refresh works again on mobile
entries.description: Swiping down from the top of the page refreshes normally in Chrome and other mobile browsers.
highlights: Native pull-to-refresh restored
Sideways page shifting stays fixed

entries.title: Mobile and installed-app polish
entries.description: A full pass over the phone experience — no sideways scrolling, nothing hidden behind the bottom bar, comfortable tap targets.
highlights: The screen no longer moves side to side on any page
The message composer and inbox sit clear of the bottom navigation
Buttons are no longer cut off on narrow screens
The app menu scrolls on short screens and moves aside when the keyboard opens

entries.title: Roles for team members
entries.description: Invite teammates as Viewer, Editor or Admin — each role sees and can do exactly what it should.
highlights: Viewer sees everything, changes nothing
Editor can reply to messages, manage leads and edit automations
Admin adds automation deletion, AI persona and broadcasts
Billing, Instagram connections and API keys stay with the owner

entries.title: Delete confirmations restored
entries.description: Deleting an automation or a lead now asks for confirmation before anything happens.
highlights: Clear confirmation dialog with the consequences spelled out
Applies to automations and leads

entries.title: Easier to find in search engines
entries.description: Practical guides, comparison pages and richer search results — so people looking for Instagram DM automation can find ChirplyMint.
highlights: New guides: comment-to-DM automation, sending PDFs in DMs, ManyChat pricing in India and free-plan limits
An honest ManyChat comparison with rupee pricing
Richer search results for the app itself

entries.title: Link-in-Bio, redesigned
entries.description: A premium link-in-bio page with themes, fonts and a featured link, plus accurate click and view counts.
highlights: 12 themes and 12 fonts — including display and handwriting styles
Featured first link with a subtle shine
Views and clicks are now counted reliably

entries.title: A look that matches the product
entries.description: Typography, colour and layout refreshed across the site, with the link-in-bio builder brought in line.
highlights: Cleaner type scale and spacing
Consistent colour system across every page

entries.title: Plan changes are clearer
entries.description: Upgrading, downgrading and cancelling now explain exactly what happens before you confirm.
highlights: A confirmation dialog spells out the consequences of every plan change
Warning before you cancel or delete anything
Top-ups apply to your balance immediately

entries.title: Annual billing explained properly
entries.description: Annual plans show their real end date and correct prices, and the right buttons appear for the plan you're on.
highlights: Dates include the year, so an annual plan no longer looks like it expires in days
Buy buttons respect the plan you're already on
Top-ups and switches are clearly labelled

entries.title: Clearer pricing and policy pages
entries.description: Pricing, help, roadmap and policy pages now match what the product actually does today.
highlights: Accurate feature lists per plan
Upcoming features clearly marked as pending approval
Privacy, terms and data policy reviewed

entries.title: Guided AI agent setup
entries.description: The AI agent now walks you through the details it needs — and stays off until it has them, so it never replies with placeholder answers.
highlights: Six-step setup with a live test chat
The agent only activates once your details are complete
Persona, tone, language and FAQs in one place

entries.title: Better AI replies
entries.description: Conversations with the AI agent are noticeably more natural — on-topic answers, mixed Hindi and English handled properly, no repeated questions.
highlights: Longer memory within a conversation
Replies in the language your customer writes in
Fewer generic or repetitive answers

entries.title: Smoother scrolling and faster pages
entries.description: The homepage and dashboard load and scroll smoothly, even on lower-end phones — with no visual changes.
highlights: Faster first load
Smoother scrolling on lower-end phones
Same look, same animations

entries.title: Team workspaces, API and developer docs
entries.description: Share one workspace with your team, connect your own tools through the API, and read the full developer documentation.
highlights: Invite teammates and switch between team and personal workspace
Create API keys with the permissions you choose
Webhooks to send new leads to your own tools
Complete API documentation inside the dashboard

entries.title: Cancellation and downgrade, explained
entries.description: Changing or cancelling a plan now tells you exactly what happens, and when.
highlights: What you keep and what changes, before you confirm
Resume option if you change your mind
No surprise charges

entries.title: Design refresh across the product
entries.description: A more polished interface on the marketing site and inside the dashboard.
highlights: Refined layout, motion and detail work
Consistent styling between site and app

entries.title: Reliability and account-safety improvements
entries.description: Behind-the-scenes work on how accounts and sessions are protected. Nothing changes about the way you sign in.
highlights: Ongoing safeguards around your account
No action needed — everything works exactly as before

entries.title: Real inbox, recipes and onboarding
entries.description: Reply to your Instagram DMs from inside ChirplyMint, start automations from ready-made recipes, and get guided through setup.
highlights: Live conversation inbox with the full history
One-tap AI pause when you want to reply personally
Recipe templates to start from
Step-by-step account onboarding

entries.title: Dark mode
entries.description: A dark theme that follows your device, plus ongoing account-safety improvements.
highlights: Light and dark themes
Follow your system setting, or choose manually

entries.title: Automated email reports
entries.description: Weekly performance summaries and milestone emails — with one-click unsubscribe.
highlights: Weekly and milestone notifications
Choose which emails you receive

entries.title: Multiple Instagram accounts
entries.description: Connect and manage several Instagram accounts from one ChirplyMint login.
highlights: Up to 10 accounts depending on your plan
Pick the account when creating an automation

entries.title: AI agent and smart inbox
entries.description: An AI assistant that answers DMs in your voice, with an inbox that shows every conversation.
highlights: Trained on your tone and FAQs
View and manage conversations
Hand over to a human anytime

entries.title: Drip sequences and flow builder
entries.description: Build multi-step DM conversations with scheduled follow-ups and button-driven flows.
highlights: Scheduled follow-up messages
Button and quick-reply flows
Track where each lead is in the sequence

entries.title: Link-in-Bio builder
entries.description: A public page for all your links, with themes and click tracking.
highlights: Custom link page at your own address
Themes, emoji and reordering
See views and clicks

entries.title: Analytics dashboard
entries.description: See how your automations perform — DMs sent, leads captured and conversion over time.
highlights: Daily and weekly trends
Per-automation performance
Best times to send

entries.title: Lead capture and CRM
entries.description: Every commenter becomes a contact you can tag, note and export.
highlights: Automatic lead capture
Tags, notes and engagement scoring
CSV export

entries.title: ChirplyMint Launch
entries.description: Automate Instagram comments into DMs — build an automation, pick a keyword, and let it run.
highlights: Keyword-triggered automatic DMs
Text, button and rich replies
Free plan to get started
